目的与范围

Contract System 是 IB-Robot 的架构抽象，用于定义系统的 observations，传感器输入，和 actions，机器人输出，以及它们从 ROS 到 tensor 的映射。它作为 Single Source of Truth，保证从数据采集、训练到部署的整条流水线中数据格式一致。

本页覆盖：

  • Contract 定义结构和 YAML 语法

  • Observation 和 action specifications

  • Peripheral 集成与 metadata 传播

  • 对齐策略和 QoS settings

机器人配置如何使用 contracts，见 机器人配置文件。实际 ROS-to-tensor 转换实现，见 协议转换。

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_builder.py:12-24, src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:24-52, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/episode_recorder.py:10-12

Contract 架构概览

Contract 抽象位于 IB-Robot 数据一致性保证的核心。通过在 YAML 中一次定义 observation-action 接口，所有下游消费者，recorder、dataset converter、inference nodes，都会自动使用相同处理逻辑。

        graph TB
    subgraph "Contract_Definition_Layer"
        YAML["robot_config YAML<br/>(Single_Source_of_Truth)"]
        CONTRACT["contract_section"]
        OBS["observations[]"]
        ACT["actions[]"]
        PERIPH["peripherals[]"]
        
        YAML --> CONTRACT
        CONTRACT --> OBS
        CONTRACT --> ACT
        YAML --> PERIPH
    end
    
    subgraph "Contract_Loading_Layer"
        LOADER["robot_config.loader<br/>build_contract_from_robot_config_dict()"]
        CONFIG["Contract_dataclass"]
        OBS_OBJ["ObservationSpec[]"]
        ACT_OBJ["ActionSpec[]"]
        
        CONTRACT --> LOADER
        LOADER --> CONFIG
        CONFIG --> OBS_OBJ
        CONFIG --> ACT_OBJ
    end
    
    subgraph "Contract_Consumption_Layer"
        RECORDER["episode_recorder_node<br/>subscribes_to_topics"]
        BAG2LR["bag_to_lerobot.py<br/>decode_+_resample"]
        POLICY["lerobot_policy_node<br/>StreamBuffer_creation"]
        
        OBS_OBJ --> RECORDER
        OBS_OBJ --> BAG2LR
        OBS_OBJ --> POLICY
        
        ACT_OBJ --> RECORDER
        ACT_OBJ --> BAG2LR
        ACT_OBJ --> POLICY
    end
    
    PERIPH -.->|"_resolve_peripheral_references"| OBS_OBJ

图：Contract system architecture，展示 definition、loading 和 consumption layers。

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:123-170, src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:197-210, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/bag_to_lerobot.py:94-117, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/episode_recorder.py:128-143

Contract 结构

Contract 定义在 robot configuration YAML 的 robot.contract section 中。系统使用 Contract dataclass 在运行时管理这些定义。

字段

类型

必需

说明

rate_hz

float

Yes

录制/推理频率，单位 Hz，别名为 fps

max_duration_s

float

Yes

最大 episode 时长，单位秒，默认 30.0

observations

list

Yes

ObservationSpec objects 列表

actions

list

Yes

ActionSpec objects 列表

timestamp_source

string

No

receive，默认，或 header

Contract 结构示例：

contract:
  rate_hz: 20
  max_duration_s: 90.0
  timestamp_source: receive
  
  observations:
    - key: observation.images.top
      topic: /camera/top/image_raw
      type: sensor_msgs/msg/Image
      peripheral: top
    - key: observation.state
      topic: /joint_states
      type: sensor_msgs/msg/JointState
  
  actions:
    - key: action
      publish:
        topic: /arm_position_controller/commands
        type: std_msgs/msg/Float64MultiArray

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:106-120, src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_builder.py:49-57, src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_utils.py:83-97

Observation Specifications

每个 observation 定义一个 ROS topic 如何转换为 tensor。ObservationSpec class 封装这些规则。

Observation Schema

        graph LR
    OBS["ObservationSpec"]
    
    OBS --> KEY["key: str<br/>(e.g., 'observation.images.top')"]
    OBS --> TOPIC["topic: str<br/>(ROS_topic_path)"]
    OBS --> TYPE["type: str<br/>(ROS_message_type)"]
    OBS --> PERIPH["peripheral: str<br/>(references_peripherals[])"]
    OBS --> SELECTOR["selector: dict<br/>(names: [])"]
    OBS --> IMAGE["image: dict<br/>(resize: [H, W], encoding)"]
    OBS --> ALIGN["align: dict<br/>(strategy, stamp, tol_ms)"]
    OBS --> QOS["qos: dict<br/>(reliability, depth)"]

图：Observation specification schema，展示内部 ObservationSpec attributes。

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:61-74, src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_builder.py:59-71, src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_utils.py:43-55

Image Observations 与 Peripheral Metadata

Image observations 可以引用 peripherals，以继承硬件专属 metadata，例如 native resolution 和 pixel formats。

observations:
  - key: observation.images.top
    topic: /camera/top/image_raw
    type: sensor_msgs/msg/Image
    peripheral: top  # References peripherals[name='top']
    image:
      resize: [480, 640]  # [height, width]

当引用 peripheral 时，_resolve_peripheral_references 函数会根据该 peripheral 的 height、width 和 pixel_format 自动填充缺失的 image.resize 与 image.encoding 字段。

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:151-170, src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_builder.py:60-71

Action Specifications

Actions 定义模型输出 tensors 如何通过 ActionSpec 映射到 ROS topics。

Action Schema

        graph LR
    ACT["ActionSpec"]
    
    ACT --> KEY["key: str<br/>(e.g., 'action')"]
    ACT --> SELECTOR["selector: dict<br/>(names: [])"]
    ACT --> FROM_TENSOR["from_tensor: dict"]
    ACT --> PUBLISH_TOPIC["publish_topic: str"]
    ACT --> PUBLISH_TYPE["type: str"]
    ACT --> STRATEGY["publish_strategy: dict"]
    ACT --> SAFETY["safety_behavior: str<br/>('hold' | 'zeros')"]

图：Action specification schema，将 ActionSpec attributes 映射到 YAML fields。

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:76-90, src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_builder.py:73-81, src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_utils.py:59-69

Action 分发

系统支持将单个 action tensor 拆分到多个 ROS topics。当不同 joint groups，例如 arm 与 gripper，由不同 ROS controllers 处理时，这很常见。

actions:
  - key: action
    selector:
      names: ["action.0", "action.1", "action.2", "action.3", "action.4"]
    publish:
      topic: /arm_position_controller/commands
      type: std_msgs/msg/Float64MultiArray
  - key: action
    selector:
      names: ["action.5"]
    publish:
      topic: /gripper_position_controller/commands
      type: std_msgs/msg/Float64MultiArray

tensormsg converter 使用这些 selectors 在发布到对应 topics 前切分输入 tensor。

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:76-90, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/bag_to_lerobot.py:101-105

数据流：从 Bag 到 LeRobot

bag_to_lerobot tool 展示 Contract system 的实际作用，它将录制的 ROS bags 转换为可训练数据集。

步骤

Function/Class

说明

1. Load Contract

load_contract

从 robot_config.yaml 加载 Single Source of Truth。

2. Scan Bag

_Stream

为每个 contract topic 累积原始 ROS messages。

3. Decode

decode_value

使用 tensormsg 将 ROS messages 转换为 contract-native forms，例如 HWC arrays。

4. Resample

resample

使用选定 timestamps 将所有 streams 对齐到 contract 的 rate_hz。

5. Export

LeRobotDataset

将最终对齐数据写入 Parquet 和 MP4/PNG 文件。

来源：src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/bag_to_lerobot.py:12-18, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/bag_to_lerobot.py:121-142, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/bag_to_lerobot.py:94-113

验证与安全

Contract System 包含启动前验证，用于在系统启动前捕获架构错误。

  • validate_control_mode_config：检查引用的 models 是否存在，以及每个 observation 的 peripheral 是否在 peripherals section 中定义。src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_builder.py:12-71

  • Safety Behaviors：Actions 支持 safety_behavior，即 hold 或 zeros。如果 inference service 超时或失败，系统会回退到该行为以保护硬件。src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:78-81

  • Fingerprinting：contract_fingerprint 生成 contract configuration 的 hash。它被存储在 bag metadata 中，确保 dataset converter 使用录制时完全相同的 contract。src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/episode_recorder.py:97-98, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/bag_to_lerobot.py:182-194

来源：src/robot_config/robot_config/contract_builder.py:12-107, src/robot_config/robot_config/generators/contract.py:76-90, src/dataset_tools/dataset_tools/episode_recorder.py:139-143
